name: onenote-ferry
description: Convert OneNote notebooks from OneDrive, OneDrive downloads or OneNote for Windows exports into Markdown for Obsidian, and keep them up to date.
author: AlcatrazYU

scripts.build:parser: cd parser/ferry && CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME/.cargo=/cargo" wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release --out-dir ../../pkg --out-name ferry && rm -f ../../pkg/.gitignore
